seo.description: Antonio Giordano: about me, background, experience and education.

title: Antonio Giordano
intro: My name is Antonio and I come from Campi Flegrei. I studied Computer Engineering at the University of Naples Federico II, graduating in 2021 after working on my AI thesis in Madrid, during an Erasmus+ traineeship, for healthcare purposes. During my university years I worked as an “Internet Crowd Worker” for Lionbridge and tutored high-school students in physics and mathematics. I then spent five years as a Functional Safety Engineer in Naples, working on automotive projects.
background: Among the university courses that shaped me most are “Business Economics and Organisation”, “Information Systems” and “Big Data and Business Intelligence”: three courses that helped me improve my teamwork skills, both as a leader and as a team member.

From 2010 to 2015 I volunteered with Freebacoli, a socio-cultural association working to promote the town of Bacoli, where I served as treasurer until I left for my studies. Its activities put me in daily contact with members from all walks of life and taught me how laws and public institutions are structured and how they work. In 2014 I directed the event presenting the association’s candidacy for the 2015 municipal elections, later won by Josi Gerardo Della Ragione, who became mayor of Bacoli.

experience.detail: Automotive functional safety under ISO 26262, aligned with ASPICE and OEM requirements (SS 7740): SW unit design and unit testing, peer reviews and code inspections (MISRA, static analysis); requirement-based test automation with ECU-TEST on HIL benches; timing and real-time analysis of safety mechanisms; SW integration requirements and architecture (SEooC, MICROSAR Safe, MCAL); DIA, Safety Plans, Safety Case and GSN argumentation, confirmation measures; FuSa, ASPICE and OEM audits; human-in-the-loop GenAI (RAG, agents) for compliance and analysis tasks.
C/C++, build systems and debug tools, integration requirements.

education.detail: ML application development for Emotion Recognition with Azure, GitHub, Python, Keras, TensorFlow and OpenFace. Final mark: Sobresaliente (10/10).
Thesis: “Multimodal analysis of emotions in multimedia”, an emotion recognition application developed on Azure/Colab. Final mark: 107/110.
Thesis: “NoSQL technologies: Sesame”, focused on the Sesame database manager implementation. Final mark: 96/110.
